name: Talen
summary: At his camp by the Zoram Strand, Talen searches for kaldorei relics along the coast. Nearby naga and Horde outposts make the work dangerous.

sections.title: Scholar on the Coast
sections.body: At a camp beside the Zoram Strand, Talen studies the past instead of taking up arms. Naga and Horde outposts make the coast dangerous, but he keeps searching the ruins beneath the waves and sands for lost kaldorei relics. He depends on travelers to face the Wrathtail naga and recover artifacts, including pristine statuettes and the Ring of Zoram, held by their leader Ruuzel.

faq.answer: At his camp near the Zoram Strand, Talen studies ancient kaldorei relics buried along the shore. He is a night elf scholar and amateur archaeologist, not a sentinel or soldier.

faq.q: Why is Talen camping near the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Talen camps near the Zoram Strand to investigate its sunken ruins and recover ancient kaldorei artifacts. Violent naga roam the beach, and the Horde outpost of Zoram'gar lies nearby, so he stays in a small camp away from the main shoreline.

Talen asks travelers to search the coast for ancient statuettes washed ashore and to hunt Ruuzel, a powerful naga on a nearby offshore isle. Ruuzel holds the Ring of Zoram, which unlocks the statuette.

faq.q: Is Talen hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Talen is allied with the night elves, but he is a scholar. He does not attack Horde travelers unless they provoke or attack him first.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the Zoram Strand recalls the Sundering. Talen seeks to preserve and recover the heritage lost when ancient coastal estates sank into the Great Sea.
Talen gives Alliance travelers a field contact in contested northern Ashenvale, near Maestra's Post.
